confidence_notes: Holistic July estimate. Restaurant anchors are more certain than accommodation, especially hostel prices because budget hostel inventory is limited. Alcohol is served in licensed venues; cocktail and wine estimates are inferred from the local restaurant beer price.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based broadly on Gulf-capital pricing comparable to Abu Dhabi, adjusted for Doha’s July heat and lower leisure demand; lodging estimates allow for limited budget hostel availability.
